provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, regular-season weeks 1 to 3 of the 2025 NFL season as played, each week its own event whose games form no bracket: kickoffs, home teams, neutral sites and scores from the ESPN scoreboard, cross-checked game by game against FixtureDownload. Teams in the 2025 playoffs keep the playoffs test file's ranking; the rest are ranked 15 to 32 by their final 2025 record from Wikipedia. Odds to win are made up from the ranking.
